title: zh-CN console: object-extension labels, server-generated notification and activity text, and several KPI subtitles stay English
body:
qa#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AecbS6JEeLdRWSW4AC

Filing gate: ③ a task on the maintainer's word. Asked in session on 2026-11-10, after the full-platform test run listed its improvement suggestions, verbatim: 「立卡处理」.

QA-source: #32135 · browser walk (runner C), zh-CN · observed beside the clauses
Batch-of: objectstack-ai/objectstack#32135 follow-ups, 15 cards filed on the maintainer's 「立卡处理」

## What we saw

Showcase in 简体中文 (framework ff04ad81):
- An object extension's label bypasses translation: the header reads "Accounts (Success Overlay)" while the activity feed for the same object reads "客户".
- Server-generated text stays English: notification titles ("Approval requested"), the Home activity feed ("Dev Admin Created Repair Ticket …"), and the language name inside a Chinese sentence ("当前为English、美国").
- Dashboard KPI subtitles ("Projects", "Tasks", "Total Budget") and the "Metadata Commit" object label are untranslated; half-width punctuation sits inside Chinese sentences on the auth settings page.
- Date formats mix within one locale ("2026/11/10 上午7:03" beside 24-hour "2026/11/10 07:24:26" in the audit log; elsewhere "Dec 10" drops the year).

## Proposed change

Route extension labels, server-rendered notification and activity strings, and language display names through the translation bundles; fill the platform-object gaps; use one date-time formatter per locale.

## Business reason

Who: every Chinese-language user and customer. Cost: a half-translated product reads as unfinished in exactly the market the showcase demonstrates.

## Reader

Triage first touch; lands across `ui/` (labels, formatting) and the services that render notification and activity text (`service-messaging`, `plugin-approvals`, activity feed).

## Duplicate check

`is:issue repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack notification title translation zh-CN server generated` (52, open and closed): #29895, #28993, #29818 are about locale tag casing and push locale, not these strings.
